picks.name: Dungen
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery. Caught two near-miss duplicates before settling here (Nikki Nair's Hyperdub EP and Severed Heads' Dark Entries reissue were both already published in October and August respectively). Exact Bandcamp album-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to the artist's confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Vidrig vår" (September 25, 2026, Skolhaus) is Swedish psych band Dungen's 12th studio album -- ten songs, their first since 2022's "En är för mycket och tusen aldrig nog," an open, personal account of a long relationship ending, produced by Gustav Ejstes and Mattias Glavå.
picks.why_listen: A different texture entirely from the electronic-heavy picks this week -- warm, melodic Swedish psych rock, useful if a set calls for a live-band interlude or a change of instrumentation.
